page.overview:
Who is Cute King?

His silhouette resembles a mushroom. The head is covered with a pink colored "mushroom helmet," with arms that have three fingers, attached to it and a tiny yellow crown on the top; the head is in the middle, and below it there is his tiny body which has horizontal colored stripes in light blue, light yellow and pale red. He also has a small face on his bud and two white legs. He also appears to have three top front teeth.

Despite his harmless appearance, he seems murderous and tyrannical. He is focused on getting his army of Cuties to fight and defeat others. He seemed saddened when his army fell down and exploded showing he does care for them, but that may just be because he wants to win.
